critical_code_review_comments: invoice_pdf.py::build_invoice_pdf() – the tail `_draw_qr_bill(...); c.showPage(); c.save()` calls showPage() unconditionally after the QR-Bill was drawn. QR-Bill helper already invokes c.showPage() before drawing → PDF ends up with a 3rd blank trailing page in some qrbill lib versions. Currently only 2 pages result (verified via pypdf) so the extra showPage() is closing the second page; this is fine but the code intent is unclear. Consider commenting or removing the outer showPage() if _draw_qr_bill returned True.

invoice_pdf.py::_draw_qr_bill – except Exception as e prints to stdout via print(); should use logger.warning() so the failure is captured in supervisor logs (same pattern flagged in iter40 for archive failures).

business_settings.py::update_settings – invoice_fields set is hardcoded and duplicated with an implicit list of columns; if a new BusinessSettings field is added later, invalidation will silently skip it. Consider computing this from the Pydantic model (e.g. exclude a small STATUS_ONLY set).

WhySafeRide.jsx – ACCENTS entries no longer define a.bg / a.fg, so `const dark = !!a.bg` is always false and the `${a.bg} ${a.fg}` branch plus the dark-mode trash icon styling is dead code. Cleanup opportunity carried from iter40 review.

About.jsx still contains two dog photo slots (dog_image_url in the 2-col grid + dog_photo_url path used to still exist earlier). Verified only ONE dog photo now renders on the live page (grid child #1 = EditableImage), so this iteration effectively consolidated to one dog block. Good.
